lines.zh: 翅尖扫过草叶，我沿着天境的微光小路走。
lines.en: Wingtips brush the grass as I follow the Aether's faint-lit path.

lines.zh: 我不停步，蝶翅在风里一开一合。
lines.en: I never stop; my wings open and close in the wind.

lines.zh: 浮岛边缘太亮，我贴着阴影挪动。
lines.en: The isle's edge is too bright; I shift along the shadow.

lines.zh: 每一步都轻，像怕踩碎脚下的光。
lines.en: Each step is light, as if fearing to crack the glow below.

lines.zh: 我绕开迷宫入口，那地方太吵。
lines.en: I skirt the dungeon entrance; it is far too loud.

lines.zh: 水晶丛间有条缝，我侧身穿过去。
lines.en: There is a gap between the crystals; I slip through sideways.

lines.zh: 风推着我走，我顺势换了方向。
lines.en: The wind pushes me along, so I turn with it.

lines.zh: 盐粒硌脚，我低飞着掠过地面。
lines.en: Salt grits my feet, so I skim low over the ground.

lines.zh: 我沿着灵魂灯的光走，不敢太近。
lines.en: I walk by the soul lamp's glow, keeping my distance.

lines.zh: 蝶翅的纹路在移动时忽明忽暗。
lines.en: My wing patterns flicker as I move.

lines.zh: 这片天境太安静，我的脚步更轻了。
lines.en: This Aether is too quiet; my steps grow lighter.

lines.zh: 我走向远处那团微光，不回头。
lines.en: I walk toward that distant shimmer and do not look back.

lines.zh: 我停在草茎上，让翅膀慢慢合拢。
lines.en: I rest on a grass stem and let my wings fold slowly.

lines.zh: 天境的风太轻，我几乎感觉不到。
lines.en: The Aether's wind is so light I barely feel it.

lines.zh: 光落在翅面上，我一动不动。
lines.en: Light falls on my wings; I stay perfectly still.

lines.zh: 我呆立着，听远处迷宫的闷响。
lines.en: I stand idle, listening to the muffled sound of the distant maze.

lines.zh: 这片浮岛安静得让我不想飞。
lines.en: This floating isle is so quiet I do not want to fly.

lines.zh: 我收起翅膀，假装自己是一枚水晶。
lines.en: I fold my wings and pretend to be a crystal.

lines.zh: 盐味飘过来，我抖了抖触角。
lines.en: Salt drifts by; I twitch my antennae.

lines.zh: 我悬在原地，看光斑在叶上晃动。
lines.en: I hover in place, watching light spots sway on the leaves.

lines.zh: 没有猎物，也没有威胁，只有风。
lines.en: No prey, no threat, only wind.

lines.zh: 我的翅纹在休息时暗了下来。
lines.en: My wing patterns dim as I rest.

lines.zh: 我贴着草叶不动，等世界先动。
lines.en: I cling to the grass and wait for the world to move first.

lines.zh: 远处有东西在动，我暂时不管。
lines.en: Something moves far off; I ignore it for now.

lines.zh: 我停得太久，翅尖都凉了。
lines.en: I have rested so long my wingtips feel cold.

lines.zh: 天境的光慢慢移走，我仍没动。
lines.en: The Aether's light slowly shifts away; I still do not move.

lines.zh: 你站得太近了，我盯着你的手。
lines.en: You stand too close; I watch your hands.

lines.zh: 我不认识你，别指望我靠近。
lines.en: I do not know you; do not expect me to come near.

lines.zh: 你身上有盐味，是从地下城来的？
lines.en: You smell of salt; did you come from the dungeon?

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，翅纹亮了一下。
lines.en: I tilt my head at you; my wing pattern flashes.

lines.zh: 你不动，我也不动，我们就这样耗着。
lines.en: You do not move, and neither do I; we wait each other out.

lines.zh: 你的影子压过来，我往旁边挪了挪。
lines.en: Your shadow falls over me, so I shift aside.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，判断你是不是威胁。
lines.en: I stare at you, judging whether you are a threat.

lines.zh: 别伸手，我的翅膀不是给你碰的。
lines.en: Do not reach out; my wings are not for you to touch.

lines.zh: 你在看我的翅纹？我合上了翅膀。
lines.en: You are looking at my wing patterns? I fold my wings.

lines.zh: 这片天境不欢迎乱走的人。
lines.en: This Aether does not welcome those who wander carelessly.

lines.zh: 你身上有迷宫的气味，离我远点。
lines.en: You carry the maze's scent; keep your distance.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，又低头看草。
lines.en: I glance up at you, then down at the grass.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就少盯你一会儿。
lines.en: Take a step back, and I will stare a little less.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，但也不想理你。
lines.en: I am not afraid of you, but I do not care to engage.

lines.zh: 你的脚步太重，惊得我想飞走。
lines.en: Your steps are too heavy; they make me want to fly off.

lines.zh: 我悬在你侧脸旁，翅纹一闪一闪。
lines.en: I hover by your cheek, wing veins flashing.

lines.zh: 你停下来，我才敢多看你一眼。
lines.en: You stop, and only then do I dare look longer.

lines.zh: 看够了就走开，别打扰我歇翅。
lines.en: Once you have looked enough, walk away and let me rest my wings.

lines.zh: 我翅面裂了一角，飞起来歪歪扭扭。
lines.en: A corner of my wing split; I fly crookedly.

lines.zh: 疼，可我更怕掉下去。
lines.en: It hurts, but falling is what I fear more.

lines.zh: 我缩到草叶下面，先缓一缓。
lines.en: I shrink under a grass blade to recover first.

lines.zh: 鳞粉掉了一地，我心疼那些粉。
lines.en: Wing dust scatters on the ground; I mourn every speck.

lines.zh: 谁打的我？我绕了半圈才看清。
lines.en: Who hit me? I circle half a turn before I see.

lines.zh: 我不叫，只把翅膀收得更紧。
lines.en: I make no cry; I only fold my wings tighter.

lines.zh: 这一下让我半天没扇动翅膀。
lines.en: That blow kept my wings still for a long while.

lines.zh: 我退到水晶后面，躲开视线。
lines.en: I retreat behind a crystal, out of sight.

lines.zh: 身上发麻，我停在原处不动。
lines.en: A numbness spreads; I hold still where I am.

lines.zh: 伤不算深，可我不想再挨一下。
lines.en: The wound is not deep, but I do not want another.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西晃来晃去，我只看不碰。
lines.en: Whatever you hold keeps swaying; I only look, never touch.

lines.zh: 那味道飘过来，我的触角转了转。
lines.en: That scent drifts over; my antennae turn toward it.

lines.zh: 我不饿，但这点微光让我犹豫。
lines.en: I am not hungry, but that faint glimmer makes me hesitate.

lines.zh: 你举着它靠近，我往后退了半步。
lines.en: You raise it closer; I retreat half a step.

lines.zh: 天境的蝶不吃这个，别白费力气。
lines.en: Aether butterflies do not eat that; do not waste your effort.

lines.zh: 我被那点光吸引，可我不想落下。
lines.en: That little light draws me, but I will not land for it.

lines.zh: 翅膀僵了一下，我又摆回原样。
lines.en: My wings stiffen for a moment, then settle back.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，我才敢靠近看。
lines.en: Set it down, and only then will I dare come closer to look.

lines.zh: 这诱饵太明显，我停在原地不动。
lines.en: The lure is too obvious; I hold my place and do not move.

lines.zh: 我绕了半圈，还是没伸手去碰。
lines.en: I circle halfway around and still do not reach for it.

lines.zh: 你撞到我了，翅面都歪了一下。
lines.en: You bumped into me; my wing surface tilted.

lines.zh: 别挤，这片草叶站不下两个。
lines.en: Do not crowd; this grass blade cannot hold two.

lines.zh: 我撞上水晶，鳞粉蹭掉了一点。
lines.en: I hit a crystal; a bit of wing dust rubbed off.

lines.zh: 谁在推我？我还没站稳。
lines.en: Who is pushing me? I have not steadied myself yet.

lines.zh: 你从侧面过来，我躲得晚了。
lines.en: You came from the side; I dodged too late.

lines.zh: 碰一下就够了，别再贴过来。
lines.en: One bump is enough; do not press closer.

lines.zh: 我撞到你的肩膀，赶紧弹开。
lines.en: I strike your shoulder and quickly spring away.

lines.zh: 草茎一弹，我们撞在了一起。
lines.en: The grass stem springs, and we collide.

lines.zh: 我翅膀擦过你，这不算打招呼。
lines.en: My wing brushes you; that is not a greeting.

lines.zh: 空间太窄，你我都得让一让。
lines.en: The space is too narrow; we both must give way.

lines.zh: 翅纹亮起来，我绕着你飞一圈。
lines.en: My wing pattern brightens; I circle you once.

lines.zh: 这不是求偶，我只是在辨你的纹路。
lines.en: This is not courtship; I am only reading your markings.

lines.zh: 两只蝶靠得太近，风都停了。
lines.en: Two butterflies too close together, and even the wind stops.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖触角，等你先动。
lines.en: I twitch my antennae and wait for you to move first.

lines.zh: 同样的翅纹，才值得我停下来。
lines.en: Only matching wing patterns are worth stopping for.

lines.zh: 我悬在你上方，慢慢扇着翅膀。
lines.en: I hover above you, fanning my wings slowly.

lines.zh: 别急，先看我们的纹路合不合。
lines.en: Do not rush; first let us see if our patterns match.

lines.zh: 天境的光照着，我们并排停着。
lines.en: Under the Aether's light, we rest side by side.

lines.zh: 我靠近又退开，还没决定。
lines.en: I draw near, then pull back; I have not decided.

lines.zh: 翅尖碰了一下，这就够了。
lines.en: Our wingtips touched once; that is enough.

lines.zh: 我叼起一小片叶屑，又马上松开。
lines.en: I pick up a bit of leaf litter, then let it go.

lines.zh: 地上有粒亮东西，我用前足拨了拨。
lines.en: Something bright lies on the ground; I nudge it with a foreleg.

lines.zh: 我只捡轻的，沉的东西拖不动。
lines.en: I only pick up light things; heavy ones I cannot drag.

lines.zh: 这片鳞粉是我的，别伸手来抢。
lines.en: This wing dust is mine; do not reach to snatch it.

lines.zh: 我抓起一根细草茎，又嫌它碍事。
lines.en: I grab a thin grass stem, then decide it is in the way.

lines.zh: 盐晶太扎脚，我碰一下就丢开。
lines.en: The salt crystal stings my feet; I drop it after one touch.

lines.zh: 我衔着东西飞不稳，只好放下。
lines.en: Carrying something makes my flight unsteady, so I set it down.

lines.zh: 这枚小石子归我，我藏在叶下。
lines.en: This little pebble is mine; I hide it under a leaf.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西我不捡，那是你的。
lines.en: I will not pick up what you dropped; it is yours.

lines.zh: 我拨弄了半天，什么也没拿走。
lines.en: I fiddle with it for a while and take nothing.

lines.zh: 那边有动静，我收起翅膀盯住它。
lines.en: Something stirs over there; I fold my wings and fix on it.

lines.zh: 翅纹一亮，我锁定了那个影子。
lines.en: My wing pattern flashes; I lock onto that shadow.

lines.zh: 它闯进我的视线，我决定跟上去。
lines.en: It enters my sight, and I decide to follow.

lines.zh: 风送来气味，我转向那个方向。
lines.en: The wind carries a scent; I turn that way.

lines.zh: 目标不大，但足够让我警觉。
lines.en: The target is small, but enough to put me on guard.

lines.zh: 我不急着扑，先看清它怎么动。
lines.en: I will not rush in; first I watch how it moves.

lines.zh: 草丛一抖，我的注意力被勾走了。
lines.en: The grass twitches, and my attention is pulled away.

lines.zh: 有东西靠近我的地盘，我盯紧了。
lines.en: Something nears my territory; I keep it fixed in view.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，翅膀绷得笔直。
lines.en: I lower myself, wings pulled taut.

lines.zh: 它还没发现我，这对我有利。
lines.en: It has not noticed me yet; that favors me.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转，找最合适的角度。
lines.en: I circle it, looking for the best angle.

lines.zh: 那团光在动，我判断它是活物。
lines.en: That patch of light is moving; I judge it to be alive.

lines.zh: 我盯上它了，但还没打算出手。
lines.en: I have my eye on it, but I am not ready to strike.

lines.zh: 它停下来了，我也停在空中。
lines.en: It stops, and I halt in the air too.

lines.zh: 影子一闪，我的触角立刻转向。
lines.en: A shadow flickers, and my antennae snap toward it.

lines.zh: 我锁定了一个方向，不再四处乱看。
lines.en: I have fixed on one direction and stop glancing around.

lines.zh: 我跟着它，不快也不慢。
lines.en: I follow it, neither fast nor slow.

lines.zh: 它往左，我就往左偏一点。
lines.en: It goes left, and I drift a little left.

lines.zh: 我保持着距离，等它露出破绽。
lines.en: I keep my distance, waiting for an opening.

lines.zh: 翅尖对着它，我随时能改方向。
lines.en: My wingtips aim at it; I can change course at any moment.

lines.zh: 它回头看了一眼，我立刻停住。
lines.en: It glances back, and I stop at once.

lines.zh: 我绕到它侧后方，那里更安全。
lines.en: I swing to its rear flank, where it is safer.

lines.zh: 这影子绕来绕去，我耐心跟着。
lines.en: The shadow weaves about; I follow patiently.

lines.zh: 它太快了，我调整了一下角度。
lines.en: It is too fast; I adjust my angle.

lines.zh: 我盯着它的动作，不眨一下。
lines.en: I watch its movements without blinking.

lines.zh: 风一变，我顺势换了追踪路线。
lines.en: The wind shifts, and I change my pursuit line with it.

lines.zh: 它躲进水晶后面，我停在缝隙外。
lines.en: It hides behind a crystal; I stop outside the gap.

lines.zh: 我不出声，只让翅膀轻轻振。
lines.en: I make no sound, only let my wings hum softly.

lines.zh: 它慢下来了，我也放慢速度。
lines.en: It slows down, and I slow with it.

lines.zh: 我数着它的步子，找出手的时机。
lines.en: I count its steps, looking for the moment to act.

lines.zh: 它往迷宫方向跑，我犹豫了一下。
lines.en: It runs toward the maze; I hesitate briefly.

lines.zh: 我贴着草尖飞，尽量不出影子。
lines.en: I skim the grass tips, trying to cast no shadow.

lines.zh: 它停住不动，我也悬着不动。
lines.en: It holds still, and I hover motionless too.

lines.zh: 跟了这么久，我还没决定要不要动。
lines.en: After all this tracking, I still have not decided whether to act.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，翅尖擦过它的侧脸。
lines.en: I dive in, wingtips grazing its cheek.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，但足够让它分神。
lines.en: The blow is light, but enough to distract it.

lines.zh: 我撞它一下，马上退开。
lines.en: I ram it once and pull away at once.

lines.zh: 鳞粉撒出去，它眯起了眼。
lines.en: Wing dust scatters, and it squints.

lines.zh: 我绕到它背后，用翅膀拍了一下。
lines.en: I swing behind it and strike with my wings.

lines.zh: 我朝你握剑的手腕撞过去。
lines.en: I dart straight at the wrist holding your sword.

lines.zh: 我贴着它飞，找机会再碰一下。
lines.en: I fly close to it, looking for another chance to strike.

lines.zh: 翅面一扇，把它逼退半步。
lines.en: One beat of my wings drives it back half a step.

lines.zh: 我冲它的手，那里最没防备。
lines.en: I go for its hands, where it is least guarded.

lines.zh: 碰完就走，我不恋战。
lines.en: Touch and go; I do not linger in a fight.

lines.zh: 它挥过来，我从缝隙里钻过去。
lines.en: It swings at me; I slip through the gap.

lines.zh: 我用身子撞它，自己也被弹开。
lines.en: I body-check it and get bounced back myself.

lines.zh: 这地方太窄，我只能短促地扑。
lines.en: The space is too tight; I can only make short darts.

lines.zh: 它退了，我悬在原地不追。
lines.en: It backs off, and I hover in place without chasing.

lines.zh: 我翅尖一挑，把它的注意力引开。
lines.en: A flick of my wingtip pulls its attention away.

lines.zh: 打一下就够了，我飞回高处。
lines.en: One hit is enough; I fly back up high.

lines.zh: 光从叶缝漏下，我抖开翅膀。
lines.en: Light leaks through the leaves; I shake out my wings.

lines.zh: 我从草茎上醒来，天境还是老样子。
lines.en: I wake on a grass stem; the Aether is as it always was.

lines.zh: 翅纹一点点亮起来，我睁开了眼。
lines.en: My wing pattern brightens bit by bit as I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 浮岛的风先碰到我，我才站稳。
lines.en: The floating isle's wind reaches me before I steady myself.

lines.zh: 我在水晶旁出现，鳞粉还没干。
lines.en: I appear beside a crystal, wing dust still damp.

lines.zh: 这里太亮了，我眯着眼适应。
lines.en: It is too bright here; I squint to adjust.

lines.zh: 我落在草叶上，先看看四周。
lines.en: I land on a grass blade and first look around.

lines.zh: 新地方，气味很陌生。
lines.en: A new place, with unfamiliar scents.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖翅膀，把睡意甩掉。
lines.en: I flutter my wings to shake off sleep.

lines.zh: 迷宫那边有闷响，我抬头听了听。
lines.en: A dull sound comes from the maze; I lift my head to listen.

lines.zh: 我出现了，但没人注意到我。
lines.en: I have appeared, but no one has noticed me.

lines.zh: 天境的光照在翅上，我慢慢展开。
lines.en: Aether light falls on my wings; I slowly spread them.

lines.zh: 我从缝隙里钻出来，身上还带着凉意。
lines.en: I squeeze out of a gap, still cool from within.

lines.zh: 第一口气息是盐和草的味道。
lines.en: My first breath tastes of salt and grass.

lines.zh: 我悬在半空，先认清方向。
lines.en: I hover in midair and first get my bearings.

lines.zh: 周围很安静，这让我有点不安。
lines.en: It is very quiet around me, which unsettles me a little.

lines.zh: 我落下的地方，草叶被压弯了。
lines.en: Where I landed, the grass blade bent under me.

lines.zh: 翅面一开，我正式出现在这片天境。
lines.en: My wings open, and I properly appear in this Aether.

lines.zh: 火燎到翅边，我赶紧往上飞。
lines.en: Flame singed my wing edge; I quickly fly upward.

lines.zh: 我从高处坠下，撞在草叶上。
lines.en: I drop from high up and hit a grass blade.

lines.zh: 水漫过翅膀，我挣扎着往上挣。
lines.en: Water covers my wings; I struggle upward.

lines.zh: 轰的一声，我被气浪掀翻。
lines.en: With a boom, the blast knocks me tumbling.

lines.zh: 有东西飞过来，擦破了我的翅。
lines.en: Something flies at me and tears my wing.

lines.zh: 那股力量缠上来，翅纹全暗了。
lines.en: That force coils around me; my wing pattern goes dark.

lines.zh: 我越来越没力气，扇翅都费劲。
lines.en: I grow weaker; even fanning my wings is a strain.

lines.zh: 雷光劈下，我眼前一片白。
lines.en: Lightning strikes down, and my sight goes white.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我朝无尽的暗处坠。
lines.en: The ground is gone; I fall into endless dark.
